title: Links, raw markup and math come through the sanitizer as today

source.name: one markdown purifier with its config set once

steps.text: Links and markup go through the sanitizer: - a web link to [the docs](https://example.com/docs "Docs") - a mail link to [support](mailto:help@example.com) - a script link [stays text](javascript:alert(1)) - raw markup shows as text and too - an autolink https://example.org/page Math still renders: $$x^2 + y^2 = z^2$$ Sanitized links done.

invariant: Web and mail links keep their targets, a script link and raw markup stay inert text, and math still renders.
